# Moira: Full Documentation Index

This document provides a comprehensive index of the Moira engine for LLMs and deep-crawling agents.

## Core Doctrines
- [Light Box Doctrine](wiki/01_doctrines/01_LIGHT_BOX_DOCTRINE.md): Rationale for transparency.
- [Beyond Swiss Ephemeris](wiki/01_doctrines/BEYOND_SWISS_EPHEMERIS.md): Competitive analysis and unique capabilities.
- [Migrating from Swiss Ephemeris](wiki/02_services/MIGRATING_FROM_SWISS_EPHEMERIS.md): Exact application-contract migration guide with Python and REST patterns.
- [Native Backend Architecture](docs/architecture/MOIRA_NATIVE_BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE.md): Dual-substrate (Python/C++) design.
- [Subsystem Constitutional Process](wiki/00_foundations/CONSTITUTIONAL_PROCESS.md): Governance and development standards.

## Astronomical Substrate
- [Nutation](moira/nutation_2000a.py): IAU 2000A nutation (2,414 terms; evaluated natively).
- [Time Systems](moira/julian.py): Julian day, UT/TT conversion, and Delta-T policies; physical hybrid model in [delta_t_physical.py](moira/delta_t_physical.py).
- [Coordinate Transforms](moira/geoutils.py): Ecliptic, equatorial, and topocentric transformations.
- [SPK Reader](moira/spk_reader.py): Native-only JPL kernel access and interpolation (no jplephem runtime fallback as of 4.0.0).
- [Eclipses](moira/eclipse.py): NASA-canon contact solver, Saros classification, and shadow geometry.

## Astrological Engines
- [House Systems](moira/houses.py): Implementation of 22 house systems with explicit polar doctrine.
- [Predictive Techniques](moira/predictive.py): Progressions, returns, and time lords.
- [Primary Directions](moira/primary_directions/): Placidus, Regiomontanus, and Morinus families; direct and converse by role exchange.
- [Draconic Charts](moira/draconic.py): Node-anchored draconic frame (mean/true node).
- [Traditional Dignities](moira/dignities.py): Domicile, exaltation, and sect logic.
- [Heliacal Phenomena](moira/heliacal.py): Rising/setting and visibility models.
- [Harmograms](moira/harmograms/): Spectral vectors and intensity doctrine.
- [Arabic Parts](moira/lots.py): A catalog of 512 lots.

## Vedic / Jyotish Engines
- [Dashas](moira/dasha_systems.py): Vimshottari and related dasha systems.
- [Vedic Dignities](moira/vedic_dignities.py): Jyotish dignity and relationship engine.
- [Vargas](moira/varga.py): Divisional charts, Vimshopaka Bala, and vargottama.
- [Yogas](moira/yogas.py): 60 classical yogas across six families as proof objects with bhanga clauses and per-yoga citations.
- [Shadbala](moira/shadbala.py): Six-fold strength plus Bhava Bala, Ishta/Kashta Phala, and Graha Yuddha disclosure.
- [Ashtakavarga](moira/ashtakavarga.py): Bindu tables, kakshya-level transit, and Shodhya Pinda (validated against BPHS Ch. 69).
- [Upagrahas](moira/upagrahas.py): Five kalavelas and five Sun-derived upagrahas (BPHS 3.61-70).
- [Avasthas](moira/avasthas.py): Baladi, Jagradadi, Deeptadi per-source tables, and Lajjitadi flags.
- [Jaimini Extended](moira/jaimini_extended.py): Rasi drishti, arudha padas, argala, karakamsa, and Chara Dasha.
- [Muhurta](moira/muhurta.py): Tara Bala and Chandra Bala personal electional scoring.
- [Sade Sati](moira/sade_sati.py): Phase classification and kernel-timed Saturn windows.

## Specialized Catalogs
- [Star Registry](moira/data/star_registry.csv): 1,809 named stars with Gaia DR3 mapping.
- [Asteroid Catalog](moira/kernels/asteroids/manifest.json): 9,974 asteroids as 399 Type-13 shards in immutable external release `2026.07.27.1`, using 10-day/7-node sampling and manifest-declared coverage.
- [Comet Catalog](moira/kernels/comets/manifest.json): 497 numbered periodic comets (1P-516P) as 20 Type-13 shards in immutable external release `2026.07.28.1`.

## REST API
- [moira_server/](moira_server/): FastAPI transport layer (`pip install moira-astro[server]`; `uvicorn --factory moira_server:create_app`). 60+ typed route families under `/v1` with Pydantic models and OpenAPI discovery.

## Verification and Quality
- [Test Suite](tests/): Comprehensive regression and unit tests.
- [Validation Wiki](wiki/03_validation/): Detailed reports on astronomical and astrological parity.

## AI Interaction
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Detailed persona and operational rules.
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): Integration for GitHub Copilot.
